stemMarkdown: The average of 25 observations was calculated as 78, but one observation was wrongly read as 54 instead of the correct value 74. What is the correct average? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: The recorded total was $25 \times 78 = 1950$. Correcting the single entry changes it by $74 - 54 = 20$, giving a true total of $1970$. The correct average is $\dfrac{1970}{25} = 78.8$.
